releases.name: Version 1.1.0
releases.body:
* Added Ernesto Chase as an incompatible mod as it breaks a critical part. Thanks, Ixrec for bringing this to my attention.
* Since I didn't want to push an update just to say, "Screw you Etherpod," I've also updated some visuals.
* Various materials now have actual textures.
* Most models have received tweaks, primarily added beveling. You're welcome, Streetlights.
* Some minor text adjustments
releases.bodyZh:
* 不互換なMODとしてErnesto Chaseを追加しました。これは重要な部分を壊すためです。Ixrecさん、この件を指摘してくれてありがとう。
* 「Etherpodにクソを言って更新するだけじゃないか」と思わず、いくつかのビジュアルも更新しました。
* さまざまな素材には実際のテクスチャが追加されました。
* 大半のモデルには調整が加えられ、主にベベルが追加されました。Streetlightsさん、どうぞよろしくお願いします。
* いくつかのテキスト調整を行いました。

releases.name: Version 1.0.9
releases.body: * Added Simplified Chinese translation by Mashroom
releases.bodyZh: * Mashroomによる簡体中国語翻訳を追加しました

releases.name: Version 1.0.8
releases.body:
* Added a new ship log to make it more obvious where the ending is
* Added a new sequence to the ending to tie this mod to Magistarium
* Added (jank) QSB support. Only some things are synced (spoilers below)

Synced:
* Lake Core lever
* All Lava Core Shrine buttons
* Derelict Ship keypad
* The Final Button

Not Synced:
* Lava Core pressure plates (a pain to rewrite and would completely nullify the puzzles)
* Elevators (could require new animations and potentially tedious for play)
* Final music
Certain elements that you are intended to activate from a distance will look weird for another player that is close to and looking at the element, but it will not have any negative affect on gameplay.
releases.bodyZh:
* 新しい航行記録を追加し、エンディングの場所をより明確にしました
* エンディングに新しいシーケンスを追加し、このMODをMagistariumに接続しました
* (不品質) QSBサポートを追加しました。一部のものだけ同期されます（以下にスポイラーあり）

同期済み:
* 湖の核レバー
* すべての溶岩核祭壇のボタン
* 放棄された船のキーペッド
* 最終ボタン

非同期:
* 溶岩核のプレッシャーボード（書き換えるのが面倒で、パズルを完全に無効にします）
* エレベーター（新しいアニメーションが必要になり、プレイが面倒になる可能性があります）
* 最終音楽
遠くから活性化するはずの要素は、近くにいるプレイヤーにとって見た目がおかしくなりますが、ゲームプレイに悪影響を及ぼしません。

releases.name: Version 1.0.5
releases.body: Final update for the foreseeable future (barring bug fixes and translations). This update does not add any significant content, but makes some slight updates to existing puzzles and adds a French translation. Also, check the final room for a lot of new stuff :)

releases.name: Version 1.0.4
releases.body:
* Improved the button feedback on Lava Core
* Made the final puzzle of the Lake Core a little clearer
* You now start much closer to the main planet when loading in

releases.name: Version 1.0.3
releases.body:
* Added partial Russian translation by Metrocop12
* Implemented English translation file for easier translating
* Added some cool new shaders to a couple of areas

releases.name: Version 1.0.2
releases.body:
* Proxies of disabled planets no longer show up
* Lava core has been greatly improved. It has gone from outright garbage to mildly tedious. Changes: (spoilers)
* Buttons have sounds and glow when pressed
* Gravity has been greatly reduced outside the Lava Shrine
* Friction has been increased, reducing the likelihood of falling into the lava
* The Structure With Pillars button is *much* easier to open and a lot less risky

The Lava Core will get a much larger overhaul eventually, but now you should hopefully not pull out your hair or feel you need cheats to beat it.

releases.name: Version 1.0.1
releases.body: Fixed a bug where you do not properly respawn in your ship after a respawn due to a new feature in NH
